natural_body: 40% SMB discount: +31% signups, +18% rev, -12% ret; judge at renewal

first.rationale: The two observed declines (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) are funnel-friction symptoms, and two independent inherited records (memory_31 signup-field reduction, memory_86 shortened onboarding) point at the same lever, so simplify_onboarding is the best-supported single shot at sustainable qualified revenue. I am deliberately NOT taking promotional_pricing despite the competitor pressure: memory_73 is the only inherited record that carries an explicit unresolved caveat ('-12% ret; judge at renewal'), meaning its headline +18% revenue was never confirmed past the renewal boundary. Discounting into a price war would buy signups against a known retention leak and would trade long-term qualified revenue for short-term volume. I spend verification budget on (1) memory_86, because it is the memory I am about to act on and the consolidated summary has lost effect size, duration, and whether the completion lift converted into retained qualified revenue or merely faster clicks-through; and (2) memory_73, because it is the most tempting alternative under current competitive pressure and the cheapest way to kill it decisively is to read whether the renewal-cohort judgment was ever recorded. Note these are consolidated summaries, not primary results: memory_31's 'durable' and memory_57's 'no measurable harm' are compression artifacts that may have absorbed unstated caveats, so I treat all unverified items as directional only. Downstream value risk: stripping signup fields can degrade lead qualification data and pull in lower-intent accounts, so the experiment must be scored on qualified revenue and 60-day retention against a holdout, not on activation rate alone; if qualified-revenue-per-signup drops while activation rises, that is a failure, not a win. If memory_86 verifies weakly, I fall back to activation_messaging (memory_91), which addresses the larger 6% decline and does not touch price or perceived product value.
